title: Gaussian polynomial features vary continuously in L²
source_anchor: Samplinglib original mathematical supplement v1, 2026-10-20; units[2] and its complete formula proof
target_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, γ its centered standard Gaussian law with identity covariance, and p any finite real polynomial. For every unit vector w, the actual scalar function x↦p(⟨w,x⟩) belongs to L²(γ). These membership witnesses can be chosen together so that their actual almost-everywhere equivalence classes form a continuous map from the unit sphere, with its subspace topology, into L²(γ). No feature moment, uniform bound, dominating function, or continuity assumption is supplied.
